items.title: Simple Analogy: Adjusting the Volume of a Speaker (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of 'Simple Analogy: Adjusting the Volume of a Speaker' under topic 6.8 (PDF 87, printed 83).

blocks.text: Hyperparameter tuning speaker ki awaz (volume) theek karne jaisi hai. Awaz bohat oonchi ho to bigar jati hai aur saaf nahi rehti. Bohat dheemi ho to theek se sunai nahi deti. Lekin jab volume sahi darje par ho to awaz saaf aur mutawazin hoti hai.
Isi tarah machine learning mein agar hyperparameters theek set na hon to model kharab chal sakta hai. Sahi hyperparameter values se model behtar seekhta hai aur zyada durust results deta hai.
Mukhtasar khulasa: 6.8 Validation and Model Improvement

items: Validation: naye data par alag jaanch; overfitting pakarti hai.
Validation data saaf, durust aur training/testing se alag; model is se seekhta nahi.
Robust aur reliable models mukhtalif halaat mein ek jaise achhe results dete hain.
Hyperparameter tuning: speaker ki awaz ki tarah settings sahi darje par lana, validation data ki madad se.
